package.name: omni_docking
package.description: Charging-dock controller for the omni inspection robot (V1): serves the Dock/Undock actions and the VerifyCharge/GetDockConfig services, holds the DOCKING control lease via the gateway string protocol, publishes the only /omni/cmd_vel/docking twist (through the velocity arbiter) and the /omni/docking/status snapshot. Fail-closed: estop, stale pose/robot state or lease loss abort the active op; the lease is always released and velocity zeroed on terminal.
